name: Schema Markup Generator (FAQ/HowTo)
summary: Generate FAQPage and HowTo JSON-LD structured data with copy-ready script tags.
description: Build schema.org FAQ and HowTo markup from simple forms. Output minified or pretty JSON-LD, optionally wrapped in a script tag for your page head.

faqs.question: FAQ vs HowTo?
faqs.answer: FAQPage is for question/answer pairs. HowTo is for step-by-step instructions.

faqs.question: Is this valid JSON-LD?
faqs.answer: Output follows schema.org types; always validate in Google's Rich Results Test before publishing.
